options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: goal_tournament
options.description: Which tournament must be won to complete the seed.

options.name: starting_har
options.description: Which HAR the player begins with. Random picks one of the 11 at generation time.

options.name: available_hars
options.description:
How many of the 11 HARs are included in the multiworld. Chosen randomly at generation,
always including the starting HAR. 11 = all HARs (default). Minimum 1.

options.name: har_stat_max
options.description: Maximum upgrade level for each HAR stat. Vanilla = 9.

options.name: pilot_stat_max
options.description: Maximum upgrade level for each pilot stat. Vanilla = 25.

options.name: buy_cost_factor
options.description:
cost multiplier of vanilla Mechlab prices (divide by 100 for precentage). 
100 = vanilla prices. 200 = 2x prices Range 1–1000 (0.01×–10×).

options.name: money_small_value
options.description:
Base credit value for a Money (Small) item. The game further multiplies this
by a per-tournament prize modifier (1×/2×/3×/6× for NAO/Katushai/WAR/World).

options.name: money_large_value
options.description:
Base credit value for a Money (Large) item. The game further multiplies this
by a per-tournament prize modifier (1×/2×/3×/6× for NAO/Katushai/WAR/World).

options.name: shop_hints
options.description:
When enabled, focusing a shop upgrade button broadcasts a hint to the AP server
so all players can see what item is at that location. When disabled, the item name
is still shown in-game but no hint is sent to the server.

options.name: difficulty
options.description: AI difficulty for tournament opponents. Matches the four OMF difficulty tiers.

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
